plan.major: Kinesiology, Exercise Science Concentration + Kinesiology, M.S.
plan.notes: Source: official Cal Poly Humboldt 2025-2026 Catalog, 'Kinesiology, Exercise Science Concentration, B.S. + Kinesiology, M.S. Combined Bachelor's and Master's Pathway 5-Year MAP'. https://catalog.humboldt.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=14&poid=8820&returnto=2302 This is a 5-year (10-semester) blended CBMP; students may double-count up to 12 units in Year 4. total_credits (141) is the exact sum of the encoded slots. KINS 690 (Thesis Writing Seminar, 3 units) appears in Semesters 9 and 10 as a multi-semester thesis; allow_repeated_courses is true for this genuine repeat. KINS 482 (Internship in Kinesiology) is listed as 2-7 units; 4 units encoded (within the range) so Semester 6 reconciles to its 16-unit header (3+4+3+3+3=16). 'MS Major Double-counting BS' slots are graduate courses counting toward both degrees. GE, American Institutions, DCG, and Elective-or-Minor slots are chosen with an advisor. Per-slot prerequisites are not published on MAP pages, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty.
